headlines.text: On a Wednesday in 2026, back when Darby Allin vs. Mike Bailey fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.52 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle. Darby Allin was chasing gold for the 10th time. In his seventh title defense in as many weeks, a battered Allin locked in back-to-back Scorpion Deathlocks ? the second broken free from a Coffin Drop reversal ? to force Mike Bailey to tap just days before his Hair vs. Title showdown with MJF.
